content.short: Perpl is a decentralized perpetual futures exchange with leverage on Monad.
content.description: Perpl is a perpetuals exchange on Monad offering leveraged positions on crypto markets. The documentation sets out its trading mechanics and the reasoning behind building another perp DEX on a new chain. It is aimed at traders wanting leverage denominated and settled natively on Monad.
content.meta: Leveraged perpetuals on Monad, the product that most rewards fast block times.
